geometry_basis: NPU / vLLM-Ascend port (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-28-npu-vllm-port-design.md) of q4km-thinking-mmproj-free-slurp-module-fold-b-np4-ctx24k-budget3072-max4096-v1: the same 24576-token per-sequence window (--max-model-len 24576), the same 1024 answer reserve and forced-close message (now vLLM's --reasoning-config reasoning_end_str), under a DOUBLED reasoning budget: 6144 + 1024 = 7168 (reasoning_budget_tokens, answer_reserve_tokens, decoding_params.max_tokens) instead of 3072 + 1024 = 4096, the thinking-budget successor of the budget3072-max4096 port fragment (owner rule 2026-10-30: accuracy-first base, the Solver was truncated at 3072; admissible only if the worst case re-measured at 7168 output tokens passes at a per-instance level >= 16), the same drop-reasoning context policy and reasoning-content guard. The number of concurrent sequences per instance (--max-num-seqs), the instance count, the tensor-parallel size, the memory utilisation and the card assignment are deployment facts: they live in the selected deployment profile (configs/deployment/*.json, core/deployment.py), are recorded in the run manifest and the vLLM runtime receipt's deployment.instances, and are NOT part of this fragment or of the protocol hash (owner decision 2026-10-28). Declared differences (design doc section 8): BF16 safetensors weights and BF16 KV instead of GGUF Q4_K_M and q8_0 KV; the server's audio tower over the original audio under native-raw-speech-query-prefix-v1 (the speech-query-prefix-v2 layout) instead of mmproj packets; automatic prefix caching instead of per-sample id_slot.
